profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lone Wolf Technologies

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Administered all functions of organization. Led teams to identify pure and risk arbitrage opportunities in non-traditional commodities. Oversaw RFP processes, negotiated supply chain domestically and internationally. Marketed and secured futures contracts for buyers and sellers to mitigate risk. Managed optimization for procurement and budget analyses. Relationship management with clients and vendors, mediated complications when necessary. Mentored successors to continue teamwork and culture within organization. 
•	Assembled 30–man remote team across multiple states with no turnover within three years
•	Ascertained multiple pure arbitrage opportunities and scaled meticulously, results include:
     o	Increased one client’s business 40% YoY, requiring tripling employees within 9 months
     o	Increased one client’s revenue 350% compounded MoM from $5k to $9MM within 6 months
•	Absolved $250k dispute between seller and buyer companies in Israel and China, respectively

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description: Reduced processing time by 15%. Optimized pallet and delivery configuration. Created physical tools minimizing task time. Implemented Six Sigma including poka-yoke and kaizen ideology. Managed MRP system with SAP software.

positions.title: R&D Engineer
positions.description: Created SOPs for validation and verification testing. Wrote technical reports with data analyzed via MS Excel and Minitab for FDA approval. Met deadline to launch new laser fiber and basket extraction tools in 6 months

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description: Presented FSAE car at Michigan International Speedway. Worked on CCLI project for NSF by creating engineering problems covering differential equations, mechanics, and machines. Integrated CCLI project into academics to stimulate relevancy and discussion
